title: GALS!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ran Kotobuki, a self-styled kogyaru queen from a family of police officers, runs Shibuya with her friends, shopping and hanging out while facing street gangs, rival gals and predatory older men (CMX blurb via MU). When she learns her classmate is doing compensated dating (paid dates with older men), she steps in (MANGA MILLION blurb via AniList). A 10-volume Ribon shoujo comedy-drama (1998-2002) about friendship, fashion and choosing your own path.
life_message: It holds up loyal friendship and being true to yourself rather than living by what parents or society expect.

content.note: Ran knocks out harassers and gang members; a teacher hits Ran and is fired (fan-wiki plot summary; MU Hot-Blooded Female Lead).
